'''Alice Schwartz''' (1925 or 1926 – September 25, 2025) was an American businesswoman. According to ''[[Forbes]]'', Schwartz had an estimated net worth of US$2.0 billion as of September 2025.<ref name="Forbes profile">{{Cite web|title=Forbes profile: Alice Schwartz |url=https://www.forbes.com/profile/alice-schwartz/ |access-date=30 September 2025 |website=Forbes|language=en}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Schwartz graduated from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] with a degree in [[biochemistry]]. While at Berkeley, she met fellow student David Schwartz, whom she married, and in 1952, the couple founded the life sciences research company [[Bio-Rad Laboratories]] with their joint savings of $720.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bizjournals.com/sanfrancisco/blog/biotech/2012/04/bio-rad-david-schwartz.html|title=Bio-Rad co-founder, chairman David Schwartz dies at 88|date=Apr 3, 2012|website=www.bizjournals.com|access-date=2019-04-11}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://califesciences.org/david-and-alice-schwartz-2007-lifetime-achievement/|title=David and Alice Schwartz|date=2013-05-18|website=California Life Sciences Association|language=en-US|access-date=2019-04-13|archive-date=2019-04-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190413192953/https://califesciences.org/david-and-alice-schwartz-2007-lifetime-achievement/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=14 Billionaires Who Earned Their Riches In Healthcare {{!}} Journal of Medicine {{!}} Medical Journals {{!}} National College of Physicians|url=https://www.ncnp.org/journal-of-medicine/2609-14-billionaires-who-earned-their-riches-in-healthcare.html|access-date=2020-10-23|website=www.ncnp.org}}</ref> Schwartz was a researcher and director with the company and was on its board since its founding.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sfgate.com/bayarea/article/All-in-the-family-Bio-Rad-50-years-later-is-2872334.php|title=All in the family / Bio-Rad, 50 years later, is still doing business in its own way|last=Abate|first=Tom|date=2002-02-18|website=SFGate|access-date=2019-04-13}}</ref> After her husband died in 2012, Schwartz's son Norman became the company's chairman and CEO.<ref name="Forbes profile"/>

According to Forbes, in 2020 she was the oldest woman on the [[List of female billionaires|richest women in the U.S. list]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Soliven|first=Ernesto|date=2020-09-09|title=Alice Schwartz Net Worth: Oldest, Richest Woman In US Is Worth $2.2B|url=https://www.ibtimes.com/alice-schwartz-net-worth-oldest-richest-woman-us-worth-22b-3042429|access-date=2020-09-21|website=International Business Times}}</ref>

Schwartz died on September 25, 2025, at the age of 99.<ref name="Business Wire">{{cite news |title=Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. Co-Founder and Director Emeritus Alice Schwartz Passes Away |url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250929203438/en/Bio-Rad-Laboratories-Inc.-Co-Founder-and-Director-Emeritus-Alice-Schwartz-Passes-Away |access-date=30 September 2025 |work=Business Wire |date=29 September 2025}}</ref>
